rows.text:
To [Trailblazer], who traveled from afar:

I keep many little booklets,
each named after one of my friends.
Every happy moment we share together
gets carefully recorded inside.
These heavy pages hold the precious weight of memories.

I've set aside an especially big, thick booklet just for you,
since joy is never in short supply when we're together.

With enthusiasm, Tilimem
